registered_before: any retained-activation ridge fit, CV, quantization or held-out evaluation
motivation: RR1 post-Q1 linear correction improves full video but leaves blur; compare a standard reconstruction baseline using already available nonlinear retained features
base: same calibration12 C-static108 groups64, centered gain/bias; keep support and native FFN0 weights fixed
features: actual retained post-Q2 V2,6912 coordinates, available after the already half-width FFN0; no omitted hidden activations at inference
training: original12 strictseed calibration images,512 uniform rows each, equal image weights; pilot block20 steps0/2
fit: center retained V2, normalize one global RMS; ridge fit gated FP32(captured denseY-native baseY), FP64 dual Cholesky; full rank correction, no output-rank truncation
folding: undo fixed gate offline (zero gate gives zero correction), add correction to alpha_FP32*effective packed W2, fold residual intercept into existing centered b2 exactly once; cast to BF16 then original native_hif4_weight_qdq(force_fp32=True)
native: no online gain or auxiliary GEMM: packed FFN0, original native GELU/Q2 over intact64 groups, reconstructed native HiF4-QDQ packed FFN2 and folded BF16 bias, original gate/writeback
CV: calibration parity two correction-only folds,6 train6 held-out; base remains fixed and pretrained on all12, so not whole-pipeline held-out CV
selection: among lambdas with native requantized/base risk<=0.50 on all4 calibration step/fold scopes, choose smallest mean ratio, tie by lambda; if none stop
heldout: test only the CV-selected lambda on frozen task0/task6 two seeds; native reconstructed/base<=0.50 in>=3/4 scopes with both seed/step coverage independently per source
controls: report unquantized BF16 folded reconstruction vs final native HiF4 requantized reconstruction on CV; CPU native BF16 held-out primary, same final BF16 parameter values in FP32 control
full_fit_if_passed: same frozen lambda, all160 positions fromcalibration12 only; weights stay HFcache, store exact BF16uint16 to avoid doubling model bytes; preserve80GiB free-disk reserve
scope: standard static weight-reconstruction baseline, no dynamic-selector or novelty claim, no acceptance without complete actual160 timing and formal20 video metrics
